A list of the people I've most enjoyed interviewing during that time would include Marvin Gaye, Laura Nyro, Booker T. Jones, Miles Davis, and more. The Blue Moment is about music by me.

feeds.title: The Jazz Centre UK
feeds.description: The Jazz Centre (UK), also referred to as The Jazz Centre UK or TJCUK, celebrates jazz music's heritage, and actively supports and promotes contemporary performance and education. The mission is to preserve promote and celebrate the art of jazz music in all its forms.

feeds.title: BabyJazz Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to BabyJazz - a new take on music, classes and entertainment for parents, babies and young children. Founded and led by singer Ruby Barker, for babies & toddlers but enjoyed by all - BabyJazz puts a swing in your step, a smile on your face and song in your heart. Its educational too! Offering high quality music, classes and pram jam gigs with Family Band.
